claim_text: 來源機構：Discover Education (Springer Nature)；資料標題：A qualitative typology of teachers’ orientations toward artificial intelligence integration in Lebanese schools；來源刊登日：2026-10-16。作者摘要報告：質性研究探討 28 名黎巴嫩學校教師對在學校整合 AI 的看法、做法與取向；作者報告教師提到的障礙包括培訓不足、缺乏機構支持，以及資料隱私與倫理使用的疑慮，並歸納出三種質性取向：猶豫使用者、早期採用者與批判懷疑者。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

title_zh: 黎巴嫩學校教師對人工智慧整合所持取向的質性類型學

original_excerpt: This qualitative study explores the perceptions, practices, and orientations of 28 Lebanese schoolteachers regarding the integration of AI in school settings. … Reported barriers included insufficient training, lack of institutional support, and concerns related to data privacy and ethical use. … The analysis led to the identification of three qualitative orientations toward AI integration—reluctant users, early adopters, and critical skeptics—reflecting differentiated levels of readiness and engagement.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究設計、樣本與作者所述的障礙及三種取向；質性描述研究，非介入研究。

summary_evidence_spans: This qualitative study explores the perceptions, practices, and orientations of 28 Lebanese schoolteachers regarding the integration of AI in school settings.

source_title: Young Learners' Motivation for AI‐Supported Extracurricular French Vocabulary Learning: A Q Methodological Study
title_zh: 低齡學習者對 AI 輔助課外法語詞彙學習的動機：Q 方法論研究
source_locator: 首發日依 Crossref published-online（出版社頁讀取失敗：Wiley 回 403）：2026-10-15；出版者 PDF（管理者 2026-10-17 提供）：European Journal of Education 61:e70907，Received 19 August 2026、Accepted 8 October 2026；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 2–4 句
original_excerpt: This study investigates primary school students' motivational typologies and the factors related to these configurations in AI‐supported extracurricular French vocabulary learning. … Twenty learners completed a Q sorting task based on 34 motivational statements, and eight participants were subsequently selected for semi‐structured interviews. … Q factor analysis identified four motivational typologies: socially supported learners, future‐oriented learners, enjoyment‐driven learners and mastery‐oriented learners.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究對象、設計與作者所述的四種動機類型；非介入研究。
scope_limitation: 同儕審查期刊論文（European Journal of Education，監測清單 J49）；國小學生 20 人（內文載為中國國小課外法語課程），Q 方法與訪談，結果不宜推論；首發日依 Crossref 上線日。
ai_crosscheck_record: 第一輪 2026-10-17 讀管理者提供的出版者 PDF 首頁摘要（與 Crossref 摘要文字相同），擇摘要第 2–4 句撰寫中文摘要；第二輪 2026-10-17 由隔離子代理逐項對照英文原句（人數 20、34 則敘述、8 人訪談、四種類型名稱、是否增添內容），判定一致。首發日依 Crossref published-online（出版社頁 403）。同一模型，非獨立審閱。
ai_lit_note: 國小學生以 AI 輔助課外學法語詞彙的動機，屬 AI 輔助學習，對應 S-LRN「應用AI工具強化領域學習」
summary_evidence_spans: This study investigates primary school students' motivational typologies and the factors related to these configurations in AI‐supported extracurricular French vocabulary learning.
Twenty learners completed a Q sorting task based on 34 motivational statements, and eight participants were subsequently selected for semi‐structured interviews.
Q factor analysis identified four motivational typologies: socially supported learners, future‐oriented learners, enjoyment‐driven learners and mastery‐oriented learners.
attributed_summary: 研究探討國小學生在 AI 輔助的課外法語詞彙學習中的動機類型及相關因素；20 名學生依 34 則動機敘述完成 Q 排序，其中 8 人再接受半結構訪談；作者報告 Q 因素分析得出四種動機類型：社會支持型、未來導向型、樂趣驅動型與精熟導向型。

claim_text: 來源機構：arXiv；資料標題："Do You Trust It... or Check It?": Exploring Children's Verification Behaviors in Game-Based Human-AI Collaboration；來源刊登日：2026-10-15。作者摘要報告：研究設計一個遊戲式人機協作探測工具，檢視兒童在任務中如何查證 AI 的建議；系統把 AI 建議嵌入生物知識推理遊戲，比較夥伴型、工具型與雙態代理三種互動風格，並以 8 至 10 歲兒童進行初步評估，結合互動紀錄、任務後評分與半結構訪談。（AI 輔助摘要，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）
source_title: "Do You Trust It... or Check It?": Exploring Children's Verification Behaviors in Game-Based Human-AI Collaboration
title_zh: 「你信任它……還是查證它？」：探究兒童在遊戲式人機協作中的查證行為
source_locator: arXiv abs 頁 Submission history：[v1] Thu, 15 Oct 2026 04:23:00 UTC；Comments: Accepted at HCI International 2026 (Late Breaking Work)；摘要歸屬：Abstract 第 3、4、6 句
original_excerpt: This paper presents a game-based human-AI collaboration probe designed to examine how children verify AI suggestions during task-based interaction. … The system embeds AI suggestions within a biological knowledge reasoning game and compares three Agent interaction styles: partner-like, tool-like, and dual-state Agent. … A preliminary evaluation with children aged 8-10 combined interaction logs, post-task ratings, and semi-structured interviews.
interpretation_note: 轉述作者摘要的研究目的、系統設計與評估方法；比較三種互動風格屬條件比較，依規則不寫結果。
scope_limitation: 預印本，未經同儕審查（作者註明已獲 HCII 2026 Late Breaking Work 接受）；8–10 歲兒童的初步評估，遊戲情境、非學校課堂；本則不涉及結果。

ai_lit_note: 兒童如何查證 AI 建議（接受、查證、質疑、修正），重點在學生使用 AI 時的查證行為，依準則判 A，對應 S-ETH「具備對AI的批判思考」與 S-LRN「理解AI輔助學習的角色功能」
summary_evidence_spans: This paper presents a game-based human-AI collaboration probe designed to examine how children verify AI suggestions during task-based interaction.
The system embeds AI suggestions within a biological knowledge reasoning game and compares three Agent interaction styles: partner-like, tool-like, and dual-state Agent.
A preliminary evaluation with children aged 8-10 combined interaction logs, post-task ratings, and semi-structured interviews.
